# Unit test for method get_nowait of class Queue
import pytest

from tornado import gen
from tornado.concurrent import Future
from tornado.queues import Queue, QueueEmpty, QueueFull


def test_Queue_get_nowait_empty_raises():
    q = Queue()
    assert q.empty()
    with pytest.raises(QueueEmpty):
        q.get_nowait()


def test_Queue_get_nowait_fifo_order():
    q = Queue()
    for item in [1, 2, 3]:
        q.put_nowait(item)
    assert q.qsize() == 3
    assert q.get_nowait() == 1
    assert q.get_nowait() == 2
    assert q.get_nowait() == 3
    assert q.empty()
    with pytest.raises(QueueEmpty):
        q.get_nowait()


def test_Queue_get_nowait_resolves_waiting_putter():
    q = Queue(maxsize=1)
    q.put_nowait("first")
    assert q.full()
    putter = q.put("second")
    assert not putter.done()
    assert q._putters, "putter should be waiting"
    result = q.get_nowait()
    assert result == "first"
    assert putter.done()
    assert putter.exception() is None
    assert q.qsize() == 1
    assert q.get_nowait() == "second"


def test_Queue_get_nowait_discards_expired_putters():
    q = Queue(maxsize=1)
    q.put_nowait("kept")
    expired = Future()
    expired.set_exception(gen.TimeoutError())
    q._putters.append(("expired-item", expired))
    assert q.get_nowait() == "kept"
    assert q.empty()
    with pytest.raises(QueueEmpty):
        q.get_nowait()


def test_Queue_get_nowait_interleaved_puts_and_gets():
    q = Queue(maxsize=2)
    q.put_nowait("a")
    q.put_nowait("b")
    with pytest.raises(QueueFull):
        q.put_nowait("overflow")
    assert q.get_nowait() == "a"
    q.put_nowait("c")
    assert q.get_nowait() == "b"
    assert q.get_nowait() == "c"
    with pytest.raises(QueueEmpty):
        q.get_nowait()


def test_Queue_get_nowait_unbounded_queue_never_full():
    q = Queue(maxsize=0)
    assert not q.full()
    for i in range(10):
        q.put_nowait(i)
    assert q.qsize() == 10
    for i in range(10):
        assert q.get_nowait() == i
    assert q.empty()
